topic: Child holds books very close? What it may mean

youtube.title: Book almost touching his nose? What it may mean 📖 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your child holds the book almost touching the nose? Here's what it may mean. 📖
குழந்தை புத்தகத்தை மிக அருகில் வைத்து படிக்கிறதா?

• Other clues: squinting at the TV, sitting too close, tilting the head, headaches.
• It may mean short sight, long sight, astigmatism, or one weaker eye.
• Kids rarely complain. They think everyone sees the way they do.
• A lazy eye responds best when treated in early childhood.
• Get a full eye test before school starts and then every year.
• Glasses, if needed, let children read at a normal distance and learn comfortably.
